headline: GPU rental prices held flat over 7 days, with MI300X leading on price-performance.
bullets: Every tracked GPU posted a +0% 7-day change, led by B200 at a $8.50 market index and H200 at $5.40.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with a $10.68 hyperscaler median against a $4.07 neocloud median.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.78 or less per PFLOP-hour, specifically $3.62, ahead of B200 at $3.78, though only 4 providers list it.
A100 80GB SXM is the weakest on price-performance at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour, despite Vast.ai's median of $1.19.
RunPod Community Cloud is the cheapest provider for B200 at $5.98, H200 at $3.59, and L40S at $0.79.
watch: Watch whether the B200 hyperscaler premium of +77% widens toward H100 SXM's +162% as more of the 12 providers add capacity.
